name.baseName: xx Ethanol, 95% in H2O, from wood, at distillery

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg hydrated ethanol 95% (dry basis, i.e. 1.05 kg hydrated ethanol 95% wet basis), respectively 1 kWh of electricity from wood (u=80%, i.e. 55% dry matter). The multioutput-process 'wood, in distillery' delivers the co-products 'ethanol, 95% in H2O, from wood, at distillery' and 'electricity, from wood, at distillery'. Economic allocation with allocation factor for common stages of 99.7% to ethanol. Allocation is done according to carbon balance for CO2 emissions.; UUID: 431a1a2d-aa33-305b-841a-06c8a6719eed

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Data from 1999 to 2006, pilot scale, near-future technology

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data is adapted to Swiss conditions from NREL ethanol process design from yellow poplar (1999)

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Ethanol is produced by dilute acid pre-hydrolysis and simultaneous saccharification and co-fermentation (SSCF) of lignocellulosic biomass. Process heat and power supply is ensured by the combustion of unconverted solids. Excess electricity is exported to the power grid.

# Included processes
This dataset includes the transport of wood from the forest to the distillery, and the processing of wood (u=80%) to hydrated ethanol (95%) and electricity. System boundary is at the distillery. Dehydration to anhydrous ethanol is not included. Process heat and power supply is ensured by the combustion of unconverted solids.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data is adapted to Swiss conditions from NREL ethanol process design from yellow poplar, modelling by ENERS (CH)

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: Passed.; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
